facts.fact: 开场三遍 I'm telling myself the story of my life
facts.anchor: I’m telling myself the story of my life.

facts.fact: 从前有个孩子有个 imaginary friend 叫 Bethany（勇敢美丽）
facts.anchor: this child had an imaginary friend, and her name was Bethany.

facts.fact: 父母送他看精神科、他拒绝 talking、只哭
facts.anchor: he refused to talk to the psychiatrist

facts.fact: 16 岁 breakdown 自杀未遂、Bethany 阻止了他
facts.anchor: When the child was sixteen, he had a breakdown. He almost ended his own life, but his imaginary friend Bethany was there to stop him.

facts.fact: 医院里要他承认 Bethany 不 real、他不肯（承认就全完了）
facts.anchor: if he admitted she wasn’t real, everything would be lost

facts.fact: 他在医院决定 make it real、child 变成 Bethany
facts.anchor: The child decided in the hospital to “make it real.”

facts.fact: 反转：Bethany 成人后也有了个甩不掉的 imaginary friend——就是曾经的自己；两人换位
facts.anchor: Once she had been the boy’s imaginary friend, and now he had become hers.

facts.fact: 契约：她让他活、他就一直活在她脑中（still very real）
facts.anchor: he lived with her. And now he was the imaginary one inside her head.

facts.fact: 两问收尾：Had she created him or had he created her? / What never stops changing but always remains static?
facts.anchor: Had she created him or had he created her?
